note: S-25/C-082: SchedTime, StartTime, EndTime and RealEndTime are the Director's local time text (TZ=UTC in the harness, catalog in another zone): they lie within a minute of each other and of JobTDate
steps: select endtime >= starttime and endtime - starttime < interval '1 minute' as start_end, starttime >= schedtime and starttime - schedtime < interval '1 minute' as sched_start, realendtime = endtime as realend, abs(extract(epoch from starttime at time zone 'UTC') - jobtdate) < 60 as tdate from job where name='parity-admin' order by jobid desc limit 1;
